newsitem.title: USA: Mt Holly, N.J., official eyes bond money -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Mt Holly, N.J., official eyes bond money -- paper.

text.p: Mount Holly, N.J., Freeholder William Haines introduced a measure to issue $5 million of bonds to preserve farmland in the area, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Thursday.
Burlington County voters approved the bond issue in a 1992 referendum, but freeholders had not issued the bonds because of a decline in farmland values.
Haines said he wanted to enter into development easements on seven farms, then get reimbursement from the state.
